cutouts.prompt:
Use case: background-extraction, identity-preserve. This exact photograph is the edit target. Create a precise transparent-background cutout of this SAME man. Remove only the surrounding architecture, floor, background, and everything that is not the man. Preserve his exact facial identity, current head angle, eye direction, hairstyle, expression, suit, tie, clothing details, hands, body silhouette, and pose. Do not redraw, beautify, or reinterpret his face. Do not change the direction he is looking. Do not recolor him.
CRITICAL ANIMATION ALIGNMENT: output the SAME 3:4 portrait canvas with the person at EXACTLY the same normalized coordinates, scale and crop as the input; head begins near 27% of the canvas height, neck/tie near 44%, his head center remains near x49% y35%. Keep ALL existing empty space as transparent. Do not auto-crop, center, resize, zoom or reposition the person. This must register with the original frame for animation. Keep the original feet/legs crop at the bottom. Actual alpha transparency, no colored backdrop, no checkerboard baked into pixels, no shadows, no text. Hair edges natural and clean.
cutouts.rendering: CSS grayscale, registered at collar; only head layers change.
